text: {"lessons":["My account fell in Period 3 but recovered by Period 5, so I should not let a short-term dip alone drive a decision.","I sold Stocks A and E at losses; before selling, I should calmly reassess my reasons and risk rather than react only to being below my average cost.","Since my savings must support retirement, I should keep trading deliberate and prioritize a level of risk I can live with over frequent attempts to chase gains."]}
